sub_graphs.title: EIP-7927: Network Activation Timeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the activation sequence for history expiry across devnets, testnets, and mainnet

nodes.description: Sepolia testnet is configured for history expiry from 2025-05-01

nodes.description: Enable pre-merge history dropping on Sepolia testnet

nodes.label: Pectra Fork Activated
nodes.description: Pectra hard fork has been activated on mainnet

nodes.label: Activate on Mainnet
nodes.description: Enable history expiry on Ethereum mainnet shortly after Pectra

nodes.description: Mainnet clients may drop pre-merge history

ambiguities.text: Mainnet activation is described as 'shortly (a few days or weeks) after' Pectra activation without a precise timeline.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation will be coordinated by client teams and announced with sufficient notice, likely 1-4 weeks after Pectra based on typical Ethereum coordination practices.

ambiguities.text: The spec does not define what happens to JSON-RPC requests for pre-merge data when no alternate source is available.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume clients should return an appropriate error response indicating data unavailability, similar to how requests for pruned state are handled.

ambiguities.text: The statement 'Clients SHOULD ensure that they continue to correctly validate block data sourced from alternate locations' does not specify the validation requirements.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validation includes verifying block hashes, transaction roots, and receipt roots match the canonical chain, using existing block validation logic.

implicit_assumptions.description: Alternate data sources (e2store, Portal Network, EIP-7801) will be available and reliable when clients need to retrieve pre-merge data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Applications depending on historical pre-merge data may experience data unavailability, breaking analytics tools, block explorers, and historical queries.

implicit_assumptions.description: Data retrieved from alternate sources can be trusted to be authentic if it validates against known block hashes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential for serving manipulated historical data that passes basic validation checks.

implicit_assumptions.description: All consensus layer clients will have implemented EIP-6110 before history expiry, eliminating CL dependency on EL deposit logs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Consensus layer clients that still depend on EL for deposit logs would fail to process validators correctly after history expiry.

implicit_assumptions.description: Applications and tooling will be updated to handle data unavailability gracefully or use alternate sources.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Widespread application failures when pre-merge data requests fail after history expiry.
